notes.title: Official links and contacts for communication
notes.content:
The game I'm working on at the moment. I'm developing for PC and mobile platforms. Don't forget to add it to your wishlist, it's very important to me:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3187120/Vitta_Lucis

[h1]Links[/h1]

I am registered in a large number of social networks, some of which I actively manage. The other part is either inactive or registered just in case. For example, it may come in handy later or was made to protect against fake pages.

[h2]Official website[/h2]

On the website you can find all the links to my projects. Also there are all the official active and inactive pages in social networks. Contacts for communication are also there:
[list]
    [*]RU https://isaev.space
[/list]

[h2]Development blog[/h2]

I try to actively share my projects, experience and development process. I make the most up-to-date news in the Telegram channel and VK community:
[list]
    [*]RU https://t.me/isaev_inc
    [*]RU https://vk.com/isaev_inc
[/list]
I also duplicate this news in a shortened form in Bluesky and X/Twitter:
[list]
    [*]EN https://bsky.app/profile/isaevspace.bsky.social
    [*]EN https://x.com/ISAEV_SPACE
[/list]
I periodically post diaries in video format, as well as short verticals on the YouTube channel and in TikTok:
[list]
    [*]RU https://youtube.com/@isaev_inc
    [*]RU https://tiktok.com/@isaev_inc
[/list]
I rarely write long articles about the development process for a certain period on DTF, Pikabu and The Daily Telefrag. I also try to tell in a shortened form on Reddit:
[list]
    [*]RU https://dtf.ru/u/1440702-isaev-space
    [*]RU https://pikabu.ru/@NanakiLucis
    [*]RU https://dailytelefrag.ru/user/75
    [*]EN https://www.reddit.com/user/isaev_space
[/list]

[h1]Contacts[/h1]

My name is Sergey Isaev, I use the nickname Nanaki on the Internet. You can contact me in private messages on Telegram and VK:
[list]
    [*]https://t.me/nanaki_lucis
    [*]https://vk.com/nanaki
[/list]
You can also write to email:
[list]
    [*]nanaki.god@gmail.com
    [*]nanaki.god@yandex.ru
[/list]

[quote=Nanaki]I love video games very much, I talk about my projects, share my experience and the development process.[/quote]
